changelog: **Program-scoped delegated admin (#1577):** `scopeForRole()` now loads an ADMIN's tier and `AdminScopeGrant` rows live and narrows the `relation` / `project` / `company` builders — ORG_ADMIN and OBSERVER keep the tenant, a PROGRAM_ADMIN reads only its granted cohorts/companies, zero grants is `NO_MATCH`; every existing caller (`/api/mentorship`, `/api/projects`, `/api/companies`, `/api/interactions`, `/api/requisitions`, the board) narrows with it. `/api/mentorship/[id]` GET/PUT pass the relation as the subject (`relationSubject()` in `authzRule.ts`) to the one permission rule, and a PUT that moves cohort/company is checked after the move too (`403 outside_scope`). Cohort-less relations are outside every program scope, by decision (`docs/role-access-matrix.md` § Program scope). Pinned by `scripts/test/authz-scope-program-admin.test.mjs` and `e2e/program-scoped-admin.spec.ts` (@smoke). The candidate list (`/api/candidates`) and `/api/users` are opened to a PROGRAM_ADMIN with `listing: true` and narrowed through the new pure `src/lib/programScopeRule.ts` (also the audit viewer's target filter); the `/admin` dashboard, `/admin/re-engagement`, `/admin/mentee-activity` and the daily activity digest narrow through `programGrantsFor()`; `/admin/contributor-terms` redirects a PROGRAM_ADMIN. Analytics and bulk edit stay 403 for the tier; admin fan-out mails are #3485.

en: A program admin now sees and edits only the pairings of the cohorts they were given — nothing else in the organisation.
tr: Program yöneticisi artık yalnızca kendisine verilen dönemlerin eşleşmelerini görüp düzenleyebiliyor — kurumun geri kalanını değil.
de: Programm-Admins sehen und bearbeiten jetzt nur noch die Tandems der ihnen zugewiesenen Kohorten – nichts sonst in der Organisation.
